title: The NPR1 agonist antibody XXB750 in heart failure: a phase 2 randomized trial
comparison_or_design: The XXB750 120-mg comparison with matching placebo within the ACEi/ARB background stratum.
time_scope: Biomarkers at baseline/week 16; worsening-HF occurrence over the article-defined safety observation period, recorded separately.
excluded: Other background strata, the 60-mg/pooled-dose groups and open-label sacubitril/valsartan
Urinary biomarkers, other safety endpoints and interim biomarker visits
population_or_material: Participants on background ACE inhibitor or ARB therapy in the XXB750 trial, preserving the actual biomarker and safety analysis populations for the specified arms.
requested_items: Table 3 selected background-therapy stratum: baseline/week-16 biomarker levels and week-16-to-baseline ratios; worsening-HF patient counts/proportions. Exclude other strata/doses, weeks 4/8, episodes, hospital-only events, death composite and protocol-planned populations.
